subject: Final artwork + contingency plan for Denver meetup swag
messages:
From: Brio Promotions <hello@brio-promo.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Initial quote + art pass for Denver meetup (PO 4398)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the scope — attached is our initial quote and the fourth art pass (artproof_v4.pdf). Line items: 1,200 embroidered caps; 1,500 compact power banks; 800 drawstring bags. Pricing includes single-site delivery to Millennium Convention Center dock (day-before delivery).

Notes:
- Caps: final embroidered logo in two-color thread (proof attached).
- Power banks: lead time 22 business days; we've put 300 units on expedited air (extra fee) to meet your cushion request.
- Bags: vendor flagged a textile dye shortage that could affect 150 units (possible backorder).

Estimated ship date: 2026-10-06. ETA at venue dock: 2026-10-11 evening.

I've attached the packing_plan_denver.xlsx with pallet counts. If you want an on-site buffer (we can split the shipment: core inventory to venue, buffer to regional warehouse for overnight routing), we can set that up — it helps mitigate last-minute backorders.

Please confirm the art or send changes. Once we get sign-off I'll finalize the PO and push the expedited qty.

Best,
Jared Molina
Account Manager, Brio Promotions
Attachments: artproof_v4.pdf (pdf), packing_plan_denver.xlsx (xlsx)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Brio Promotions <hello@brio-promo.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial quote + art pass for Denver meetup (PO 4398)

Jared — thanks for the quick turnaround and the call earlier. A few quick items from our side:

1) Art: the cap embroidery looks good but increase the safety margin around the zipper line by 2mm (see comments in artproof_v4).
2) Buffer: yes — please split as you suggested. Ship 1,000 caps + 1,200 power banks + 650 bags direct to Millennium dock (primary). Move remaining 200 caps + 300 power banks + 150 bags to Brio regional warehouse in Phoenix for on-demand routing.
3) Expedited: approve the 300 power banks on air. Charge us the expedited line item and note in the invoice.
4) Backorder contingency: if dye shortage pushes more than 100 bag units to backorder, please substitute 100 additional drawstring bags with branded lanyards + one-off promo card (we will accept substitution to avoid a shortfall at the booth).

Can you update the PO and send a final packing plan and a consolidated PO_4398_signed.pdf for internal sign-off? We're looping Lauren on logistics and Vanessa on vendor ops.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Field Marketing (Events) | Redwood Inference
From: Brio Promotions <hello@brio-promo.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Bcc: ops@brio-promo.com
Date: 2026-10-06T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Updated PO and partial ship plan + dye shortage update

Hi Mateo —

Per your instructions we've updated PO-4398 and attached the signed PDF (PO-4398_signed.pdf). Key changes: split ship applied, expedited 300 power banks by air, and a substitution plan for bags if the dye shortage exceeds thresholds.

Important update on dye shortage: supplier confirmed a 180-unit shortfall (not 150 as earlier flagged). We recommend the substitution of 180 drawstring bags with 180 branded lanyards + promo cards (matching Mateo's approval).

Shipping cadence:
- Partial to Millennium dock (truck): scheduled pickup 2026-10-06, ETA 2026-10-11 (evening).
- Buffer to Phoenix regional warehouse (ground): pickup 2026-10-07, stocked 2026-10-09.

Attachments: revised packing_plan_denver.xlsx, PO-4398_signed.pdf.

Let us know if you want us to hold the Phoenix buffer and instead route directly to the venue on the morning of 2026-10-12 (we can do same-day freight but need written authorization).

Best,
Jared Molina
Brio Promotions
Attachments: PO-4398_signed.pdf (pdf), packing_plan_denver.xlsx (xlsx)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Brio Promotions <hello@brio-promo.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Millennium Venue Logistics <ops@millenniumvenue.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated PO and partial ship plan + dye shortage update

Thanks Jared — received and reviewed. Final decisions:

- Approve substitution of 180 drawstring bags -> 180 lanyards + promo cards. Please match lanyard color to brand navy.
- Leave the Phoenix buffer in place. We will authorize same-day pull only if a day-of shortfall is detected. Vanessa and Lauren will confirm by 09:00 MDT on 2026-10-12 if a direct pull is needed.
- Please add a 2-person crate labeling team on the BOL so venue staff can spot-check pallets faster (labeling spec included in packing_plan_denver.xlsx).

Millennium ops — tagging you so you have the PO and final pallet counts. Jared, please send final ASN (Advance Shipping Notice) once truck is on the road.

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Field Marketing (Events) | Redwood Inference
Attachment references: PO-4398_signed.pdf, packing_plan_denver.xlsx
